- **Installing now? Use [v0.4.1](https://github.com/cwg-rpg-community/uploader/releases/tag/v0.4.1) instead.** The Leaderboard's approval page moved, so v0.4.0 can no longer start a new Battle.net connection.
- Uploads now require Battle.net approval through the CWG Leaderboard. The Windows tray has a native sign-in window and shows when authentication blocks automatic uploads.
- The Windows and Linux console apps can authenticate at startup. Use `--non-interactive` for unattended runs with a saved credential.
